array.string: LOG_FILE="/Users/kylemacmini/Library/Logs/routespark-pcf-archive-sync-cluster.log"; PCF_DIR="/Users/kylemacmini/projects/pcf_pipeline"; PCF_VENV_PYTHON="$PCF_DIR/.venv/bin/python"; echo "$(date): Starting PCF archive sync (cluster)" >> "$LOG_FILE"; if ssh -o ConnectTimeout=3 -o BatchMode=yes keylay@192.168.1.40 true >/dev/null 2>&1; then export PCF_ARCHIVE_REMOTE="keylay@192.168.1.40:/mnt/archive/pcf/pcf_archive"; echo "$(date): Using LAN archive target 192.168.1.40" >> "$LOG_FILE"; else export PCF_ARCHIVE_REMOTE="keylay@100.72.199.115:/mnt/archive/pcf/pcf_archive"; echo "$(date): Falling back to Tailscale archive target 100.72.199.115" >> "$LOG_FILE"; fi; cd "$PCF_DIR"; "$PCF_VENV_PYTHON" scripts/sync_archive_to_server.py --delete-local >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1; echo "$(date): PCF archive sync complete (cluster)" >> "$LOG_FILE"
